undulation.criterion: many shallow bumps, not one deep protrusion: high spot count, low elongation

thin_tube.criterion: ONE high-aspect protrusion of small diameter, activator at the tip

thick_tube.criterion: one protrusion, LARGER diameter than the thin case at the same length

branching.criterion: a protrusion that BIFURCATES -- the tube count rises over time

budding.criterion: multiple localised outward buds from the shell (the 'coral' regime), no single dominant axis
